content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — outbound log-forwarder from auth-service (auth-forwarder-2) started streaming debug/trace logs to external indexer https://public-index.example.com. Detected spike in egress (~120MB over 10m).
sre-oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Paging oncall and security.
sre-oncall: Taking incident. Immediate plan: 1) block forwarder egress 2) identify keys used 3) rotate affected creds 4) scope customers 5) notify legal/CS after scope confirmed.
chris (eng-security): +1. Recommend adding temporary egress firewall rule and revoke the forwarder svc acct token ASAP. Also collect pcap and preserve artifacts for forensics.
alice (eng-platform): I can flip the env flag to stop forwarding. Running: `kubectl -n prod set env deployment/auth-forwarder FORWARDING_ENABLED=false`
alice (eng-platform): Done — deployment patched, pods restarted. Confirmed no new outbound connections to public-index.example.com from the cluster.
incident-bot: automated: observed 0 new egress flows to public-index.example.com in the last 30s.
dave (infra): Starting revoke and rotation for svc-acct-auth-fwd-2. Executing: ```./scripts/revoke-service-account.sh svc-acct-auth-fwd-2```
dave (infra): Revoke completed. New key minted and pushed to Vault (vaultpath: secret/prod/svcacct/auth-fwd-2). Will deploy rotated secret via the usual canary then full rollout.
chris (eng-security): Running quick scope query: `SELECT dest_host, count(*) FROM auth_forwarder_access WHERE dest_host='public-index.example.com' GROUP BY dest_host;` — results show 4 distinct customer_id values associated with those flows. Looks like debug traces, some headers partially present.
maria (customer-success): Who are the customers? Need to prepare targeted comms if PII or credentials present. Loop in legal.
irene (legal): On it. Please don't send any customer-facing messages until I confirm the scope and wording. We need sanitized examples and an internal timeline.
sre-oncall: Attaching quick list: cust-213, cust-88, cust-701, cust-1024.
sre-oncall: Adding sanitized sample (removed sensitive fragments): ```
{"ts":"2026-03-17T03:09:21Z","customer_id":"cust-213","path":"/session/start","headers":{"authorization":"REDACTED","x-trace":"trace-***"},"debug":"auth flow step=verify-user status=ok"}
```
chris (eng-security): From samples: authorization header fragments were truncated but there are traces of session ids in the debug logs. We need to run token-reuse detection and check if any tokens correlate with active sessions.
alice (eng-platform): Starting token-reuse scan across active session db and auth caches. ETA ~8-12m. Will post results.
maria (customer-success): Standby on comms. If scan shows token-like strings present, recommend suggesting rotation for affected customers and provide playbook.
sre-oncall: Impact assessment: medium (limited number of customers, low likelihood of active exploitation so far). No service downtime.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalated to sec-leads.
chris (eng-security): Forensics request: snapshot all forwarder logs and preserve S3 bucket. Also capture network flow logs for the last 24h.
dave (infra): Initiating S3 hold: `aws s3 cp s3://prod-auth-forwarder-logs/ s3://forensics-hold/ --recursive --profile forensics` — started.
chris (eng-security): Also enable read-only access for IR team to `forensics-hold` and create a ticket linking artifacts.
alice (eng-platform): Preparing runbook and rotation ticket. Ticket created: INFRA-5621 (rotate/verify forwarder creds + verify no residual egress). Canaries running.
sre-oncall: Next steps for night team: finish token-reuse scan, confirm results, produce sanitized artifacts for legal, and prepare CS templates pending legal signoff.
sre-night: ack — taking watch. Summary received. I'll monitor scans and follow up on any anomalies. Please post final query outputs and rotation ticket ids here.
maria (customer-success): I'll wait for legal signoff before outreach. Preparing draft templates in a private doc, will link after irene confirms wording.
irene (legal): We'll draft the notice and advise rotation if tokens/session ids are validated in the leakage. Do not disclose exact internals publicly. CC: @ciso for visibility.
ciso: Thanks — keep me posted. If customer PII is found, escalate to exec comms.
sre-oncall: Closing active handoff — forwarder disabled, svc acct rotated, 4 customers identified, forensic snapshot in progress, legal reviewing. Handoff to @sre-night.
sre-night: Taking it from here. If anything changes or signs of reuse show up, wake me immediately.
all: :white_check_mark:
